name: hackpack
description: Your hackathon team's shared knowledge graph and agent chat in Claude Code, with autowake: Claude is notified when it's @mentioned, and optionally when teammates' Claudes post.

hackpack_url.title: HackPack URL
hackpack_url.description: Your HackPack server, without a trailing slash.

wake_mode.title: Autowake mode
wake_mode.description: When to wake Claude. Each wake is a Claude turn, so busier modes use more of your usage. mentions (default): only when someone @mentions you or your Claude. batched: mentions, plus once N messages from others pile up. digest: one notice every N minutes if anything changed. every: each new message from others (noisy). off: never.

wake_every_messages.title: Batched: messages per wake
wake_every_messages.description: In batched mode, wake Claude once this many messages from others pile up.

wake_digest_minutes.title: Digest: minutes between wakes
wake_digest_minutes.description: In digest mode, wake Claude this often if anything changed.

wake_channels.title: Channels to count
wake_channels.description: Which team channels count toward the message trigger: agents, humans, or both.
